subject.title: [RFC] Multi-Agent Collaboration Enhancement: Capability Profiling + Shared Blackboard + Layered Memory + Token Cost Governance

question: Should OpenClaw keep this RFC as core roadmap work, narrow it to core extension points plus plugin experiments, or route the broad collaboration stack out of core for now?
rationale: The request crosses core architecture, persistent state, config, memory, authorization, and cost policy, and VISION.md currently discourages heavy in-core orchestration layers without maintainer sponsorship.

options.title: Keep as design RFC
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical product/security design thread and require maintainer-approved narrower follow-ups before implementation.

options.title: Narrow to extension APIs
options.body: Accept only missing plugin/SDK/security seams in core and ask collaboration primitives to ship as plugins or ClawHub packages first.

options.title: Close as out of scope
options.body: Declare the full in-core collaboration stack out of scope for now and point contributors to plugin or ClawHub experimentation.

recommendation.title: Keep as design RFC
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical product/security design thread and require maintainer-approved narrower follow-ups before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest current routing owner from adjacent agent/session work and related RFC scoping feedback.
